    A criterion for band bricks #

    If no position p ≠ q of a primitive band lies in both plus sets of the halves of q, then every band module M(b, t) is a brick (isBrick_of_plusSets). An endomorphism minus a scalar kills the pair functor at first, hence at every position, so it sends each block vector x_q into the denominator at q, whose positions are excluded by the hypothesis. A band through pairwise distinct vertices satisfies the criterion (isBrick_of_vtx_injective).
